name: Meteoric-Pingo
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the south, impact-scarred wastelands. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
Standing still, you feel the frozen air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself.
Surveyors date the derelict space station in orbit to before the region's last cataclysm, which should be impossible. The structures are unweathered, as if time skipped this place.
Archaeologists and weapons engineers circle the same sites, quoting each other's permits with disgust. The ruins tolerate both, so far.
